'''Emppu Praji-Barck''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]]. She lived at some point between [[4800 BBY]] and [[4225 BBY]].

==Biography==
Praji-Barck served as the [[Minister of State]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for six decades. During that time, she continually filibustered any attempts to bring about Republic intervention in the [[Kaikielius system/Legends|Kaikielius system]], to stop [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity there. [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] was home to the [[House Vahali/Legends|House Vahali]], a rival family of the Prajii, and Praji-Barck watched as the planet's problems cost the Vahali most of their money. In [[4225 BBY]], Republic troops were finally sent to Kaikielius and Praji-Barck's great nephew [[Derrica Praji]] accompanied them, although he worried that his actions would anger his aunt. Praji-Barck secretly manipulated the [[Odominic]] kajidic into supplying both sides in the conflict, but Derrica discovered some [[Data-tape/Legends|datatapes]] that proved what she had done.
